    const rightInput = pane.querySelector('[data-compare-b]');
    const leftList = pane.querySelector('#compare-options-a');
    const rightList = pane.querySelector('#compare-options-b');
    const swapButton = pane.querySelector('[data-compare-swap]');
    const copyButton = pane.querySelector('[data-compare-copy]');
    const result = pane.querySelector('[data-compare-result]');
    let options = [];

    const optionData = type => type === 'group'
      ? [...new Set(dealers.flatMap(dealer => Object.values(dealer.canais || {})
        .map(channelData => canonicalGroup(channelData.grupo))))]
        .sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right, 'pt-BR'))
        .map(group => ({ key: group, label: group, search: normalize(group) }))
      : dealers.slice().sort((left, right) => left.nome.localeCompare(right.nome, 'pt-BR'))
        .map(dealer => ({
          key: dealer.k,
          label: `${dealer.nome} · BIR ${dealer.bir || '-'}`,
          search: normalize(`${dealer.nome} ${dealer.bir || ''}`),
        }));
    const populate = () => {
      options = optionData(typeSelect.value);
      const html = options.map(option => `<option value="${escapeHtml(option.label)}"></option>`).join('');
      leftList.innerHTML = html;
      rightList.innerHTML = html;
      leftInput.value = '';
      rightInput.value = '';
      swapButton.disabled = true;
      copyButton.disabled = true;
      result.className = 'dealerx-empty comparison-empty';
      result.innerHTML = `<strong>Escolha ${typeSelect.value === 'group' ? 'um grupo' : 'uma concessionária'} para começar.</strong><span>A pesquisa aceita nome ou BIR.</span>`;
    };
    const resolveOption = input => {
      const query = normalize(input.value);
      if (!query) return { key: '', option: null, ambiguous: false };
      const exact = options.find(option => normalize(option.label) === query || normalize(option.key) === query);
      if (exact) return { key: exact.key, option: exact, ambiguous: false };
      const matches = options.filter(option => option.search.includes(query));
      return matches.length === 1
        ? { key: matches[0].key, option: matches[0], ambiguous: false }
        : { key: '', option: null, ambiguous: matches.length > 1 };
    };
    const entityItems = (type, key, channel) => {
      if (!key) return [];
      return dealers.filter(dealer => dealer.canais?.[channel] && (
        type === 'group'
          ? canonicalGroup(dealer.canais[channel].grupo) === key
          : dealer.k === key
      ));
    };
    const deltaText = (kpi, left, right) => {
      if (left == null || right == null) return '-';
      const difference = Number(left) - Number(right);
      const sign = difference > 0 ? '+' : '';
      if (['quantidade', 'emails_enviados', 'emails_entregues', 'quantidade_retorno'].includes(kpi)) {
        return `${sign}${Math.round(difference).toLocaleString('pt-BR')}`;
      }
      if (['estrelas', 'nota_test_drive'].includes(kpi)) return `${sign}${difference.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}`;
      return `${sign}${difference.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')} p.p.`;
    };
    const deltaClass = (channel, kpi, left, right) => {
      if (left == null || right == null || Number(left) === Number(right)) return 'neutral';
      const lowerIsBetter = (data.canais?.[channel]?.menor_melhor || []).includes(kpi);
      const leftIsBetter = lowerIsBetter ? Number(left) < Number(right) : Number(left) > Number(right);
      return leftIsBetter ? 'good' : 'bad';
    };
    const barWidth = (value, kpi, peer) => {
      if (value == null) return 0;
      if (['quantidade', 'emails_enviados', 'emails_entregues', 'quantidade_retorno'].includes(kpi)) {
        return Math.max(4, Math.min(100, Number(value) / Math.max(1, Number(value), Number(peer || 0)) * 100));
      }
      if (['estrelas', 'nota_test_drive'].includes(kpi)) return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(value) / 5 * 100));
      if (kpi.startsWith('nps_')) return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (Number(value) + 100) / 2));
      return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(value)));
    };
    const comparisonCard = (channel, kpi, label, leftValue, rightValue, hasRight) => `
      <article class="comparison-kpi-card">
        <div class="comparison-kpi-head"><span>${escapeHtml(label)}</span>${hasRight ? `<strong class="comparison-delta ${deltaClass(channel, kpi, leftValue, rightValue)}">${deltaText(kpi, leftValue, rightValue)}</strong>` : ''}</div>
        <div class="comparison-measure"><span>A</span><strong class="${objectiveClass(channel, kpi, leftValue)}">${formatValue(leftValue, kpi)}</strong><i><b style="--comparison-width:${barWidth(leftValue, kpi, rightValue)}%"></b></i></div>
        ${hasRight ? `<div class="comparison-measure secondary-measure"><span>B</span><strong class="${objectiveClass(channel, kpi, rightValue)}">${formatValue(rightValue, kpi)}</strong><i><b style="--comparison-width:${barWidth(rightValue, kpi, leftValue)}%"></b></i></div>` : ''}
      </article>`;

    const render = () => {
      const type = typeSelect.value;
      const left = resolveOption(leftInput);
      const right = resolveOption(rightInput);
      if (!left.key) {
        result.className = 'dealerx-empty comparison-empty';
        result.innerHTML = `<strong>${left.ambiguous ? 'Há mais de um resultado com esse texto.' : 'Selecione um resultado A válido.'}</strong><span>${left.ambiguous ? 'Digite mais detalhes do nome ou o BIR.' : 'Use a pesquisa para localizar a unidade ou o grupo.'}</span>`;
        copyButton.disabled = true;
        return;
      }
      if (rightInput.value.trim() && !right.key) {
        result.className = 'dealerx-empty comparison-empty';
        result.innerHTML = `<strong>${right.ambiguous ? 'O resultado B está ambíguo.' : 'O resultado B não foi encontrado.'}</strong><span>Refine o nome ou apague o campo para analisar apenas A.</span>`;
        copyButton.disabled = true;
        return;
      }
      const hasRight = Boolean(right.key);
      if (left.option) leftInput.value = left.option.label;
      if (right.option) rightInput.value = right.option.label;
      swapButton.disabled = !hasRight;
      const leftName = left.option?.label || left.key;
      const rightName = right.option?.label || right.key;
      const keyMetrics = ['nps_index', 'quantidade', 'taxa_resposta', 'data_quality'];
      const channelBlocks = ['vn', 'pv'].map(channel => {
        const leftItems = entityItems(type, left.key, channel);
        const rightItems = entityItems(type, right.key, channel);
        const leftValue = aggregateValues(leftItems, channel, keys);
        const rightValue = hasRight ? aggregateValues(rightItems, channel, keys) : {};
        const metadata = data.canais[channel] || {};
        const kpis = metadata.kpis || [];
        const comparable = kpis.filter(kpi => metadata.objetivos?.[kpi] != null
          && leftValue[kpi] != null && rightValue[kpi] != null);
        let leftWins = 0;
        let rightWins = 0;
        let ties = 0;
        comparable.forEach(kpi => {
          if (Number(leftValue[kpi]) === Number(rightValue[kpi])) ties += 1;
          else if (deltaClass(channel, kpi, leftValue[kpi], rightValue[kpi]) === 'good') leftWins += 1;
          else rightWins += 1;
        });
        const insight = hasRight
          ? `A lidera em ${leftWins} indicador${leftWins === 1 ? '' : 'es'}; B em ${rightWins}; ${ties} empate${ties === 1 ? '' : 's'}.`
          : 'Resultado individual com cores comparadas às metas do canal.';
        const cards = keyMetrics.filter(kpi => kpis.includes(kpi)).map(kpi => comparisonCard(
          channel,
          kpi,
          metadata.rotulos?.[kpi] || kpi,
          leftValue[kpi],
          rightValue[kpi],
          hasRight,
        )).join('');
        const rows = kpis.map(kpi => `<tr><td class="name">${escapeHtml(metadata.rotulos?.[kpi] || kpi)}</td><td class="${objectiveClass(channel, kpi, leftValue[kpi])}">${formatValue(leftValue[kpi], kpi)}</td>${hasRight ? `<td class="${objectiveClass(channel, kpi, rightValue[kpi])}">${formatValue(rightValue[kpi], kpi)}</td><td class="${deltaClass(channel, kpi, leftValue[kpi], rightValue[kpi])}">${deltaText(kpi, leftValue[kpi], rightValue[kpi])}</td>` : ''}</tr>`).join('');
        return `<section class="comparison-channel-card channel-${channel}"><div class="dealerx-title ${channel}"><span>${channel === 'vn' ? 'Vendas' : 'Pós-Venda'}</span><small>${escapeHtml(activePeriod.toUpperCase())}</small></div><p class="comparison-insight">${escapeHtml(insight)}</p><div class="comparison-kpi-grid">${cards}</div><details class="comparison-details"><summary>Ver todos os indicadores</summary><div class="dealerx-scroll"><table class="dealerx-table comparison-table"><thead><tr><th>Indicador</th><th>Resultado A</th>${hasRight ? '<th>Resultado B</th><th>Diferença A − B</th>' : ''}</tr></thead><tbody>${rows}</tbody></table></div></details></section>`;
      }).join('');
      result.className = 'dealerx-comparison-result';
      result.innerHTML = `<div class="comparison-hero"><article class="comparison-entity-card entity-a"><span>Resultado A</span><strong>${escapeHtml(leftName)}</strong></article><div class="comparison-versus">${hasRight ? 'versus' : 'análise'}</div>${hasRight ? `<article class="comparison-entity-card entity-b"><span>Resultado B</span><strong>${escapeHtml(rightName)}</strong></article>` : `<article class="comparison-entity-card entity-period"><span>Período</span><strong>${escapeHtml(activePeriod.toUpperCase())}</strong></article>`}</div><div class="comparison-channel-grid">${channelBlocks}</div>`;
      copyButton.disabled = false;
    };

    const copyComparison = async () => {
      const tables = [...result.querySelectorAll('.comparison-table')];
      if (!tables.length) return;
      const original = copyButton.textContent;
      const text = tables.map(table => tableText(table)).join('\n\n');
      const html = `<meta charset="utf-8">${tables.map(table => `<table border="1" style="border-collapse:collapse;font-family:Calibri,Arial,sans-serif">${table.innerHTML}</table>`).join('<br>')}`;
      try {
        if (navigator.clipboard?.write && typeof ClipboardItem === 'function') {
          await navigator.clipboard.write([new ClipboardItem({
            'text/html': new Blob([html], { type: 'text/html' }),
            'text/plain': new Blob([text], { type: 'text/plain' }),
          })]);
        } else if (navigator.clipboard?.writeText) await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
        else throw new Error('Cópia não suportada');
        copyButton.textContent = 'Comparativo copiado';
      } catch (_) {
        copyButton.textContent = 'Cópia bloqueada';
      }
      setTimeout(() => { copyButton.textContent = original; }, 1600);
    };

    typeSelect.addEventListener('change', populate);
    pane.querySelector('[data-compare-go]').addEventListener('click', render);
    [leftInput, rightInput].forEach(input => input.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
      if (event.key === 'Enter') render();
    }));
    swapButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const previousLeft = leftInput.value;
      leftInput.value = rightInput.value;
      rightInput.value = previousLeft;
      render();
    });
    copyButton.addEventListener('click', copyComparison);
    pane.querySelectorAll('[data-compare-period]').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      activePeriod = button.dataset.comparePeriod;
      keys = presetMonthKeys(activePeriod);
      pane.querySelectorAll('[data-compare-period]').forEach(item => item.classList.toggle('active', item === button));
      pane.querySelector('[data-compare-period-label]').textContent = `${activePeriod.toUpperCase()} · ${periodDescription(keys)}`;
      if (leftInput.value.trim()) render();
    }));
    populate();
  }

  setupEntityComparisonV2();
}, 0);

(() => {
  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const loading = $('serverLoading');
  const message = $('serverMessage');

  function storageGet(key) {
    try { return window.sessionStorage.getItem(key); } catch (_) { return null; }
  }

  function storageSet(key, value) {
    try { window.sessionStorage.setItem(key, value); } catch (_) {}
  }

  function showLoading(show) {
    if (loading) loading.classList.toggle('active', Boolean(show));
  }

  function setMessage(text, type = '') {
    if (!message) return;
    message.textContent = text || '';
    message.className = `server-message${type ? ` ${type}` : ''}`;
  }

  function switchMainTab(target, button) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.dashboard-section').forEach(section => {
      section.classList.toggle('active', section.id === target);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab-target]').forEach(tab => {
      const active = tab === button;
      tab.classList.toggle('active', active);
      if (active) tab.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page');
      else tab.removeAttribute('aria-current');
    });
    storageSet('geely.activeSection', target);
    try { window.scrollTo({ top: 82, behavior: 'smooth' }); }
    catch (_) { window.scrollTo(0, 82); }
    try { button?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest', inline: 'center' }); }
    catch (_) {}
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab-target]').forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', event => {
      event.preventDefault();
      switchMainTab(button.dataset.tabTarget, button);
    });
  });

  const hashTab = (window.location.hash || '').replace(/^#/, '');
  const savedTab = hashTab || storageGet('geely.activeSection');
  if (savedTab) {
    const button = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab-target]')]
      .find(tab => tab.dataset.tabTarget === savedTab);
    if (button) switchMainTab(savedTab, button);
  }
  document.documentElement.classList.remove('no-js');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('js-ready');

  function activatePanel(kind, target) {
    document.querySelectorAll(`[data-${kind}-panel]`).forEach(panel => {
      panel.classList.toggle('active', panel.dataset[`${kind}Panel`] === target);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll(`[data-${kind}-target]`).forEach(button => {
      button.classList.toggle('active', button.dataset[`${kind}Target`] === target);
    });
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-ranking-target]').forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', event => {
      event.preventDefault();
      activatePanel('ranking', button.dataset.rankingTarget);
    });
  });
  activatePanel('ranking', 'vn');

  const rankingSearch = $('rankingDealerSearch');
  const rankingChoices = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-ranking-dealer-choice]')];
  const rankingClear = document.querySelector('[data-ranking-filter-clear]');
  const rankingSelection = $('rankingDealerSelection');
  const rankingFilter = document.querySelector('[data-ranking-filter]');
  const rankingToggle = document.querySelector('[data-ranking-filter-toggle]');

  function setRankingMenu(open) {
    if (!rankingFilter || !rankingToggle) return;
    rankingFilter.classList.toggle('open', open);
    rankingToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
    if (open) rankingSearch?.focus();
  }

  function normalizeSearch(value) {
    const text = String(value || '');
    const normalized = typeof text.normalize === 'function' ? text.normalize('NFD') : text;
    return normalized.replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').toLowerCase().trim();
  }

  function filterRankingOptions() {
    const search = normalizeSearch(rankingSearch?.value);
    let visible = 0;
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-ranking-dealer-option]').forEach(option => {
      const show = !search || (option.dataset.search || '').includes(search);
      option.classList.toggle('hidden', !show);
      if (show) visible += 1;
    });
    document.querySelector('[data-ranking-dealer-no-results]')?.classList.toggle('hidden', visible > 0);
  }

  function filterRankingRows() {
    const selected = new Set(rankingChoices.filter(choice => choice.checked).map(choice => choice.value));
    const hasSelection = selected.size > 0;
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-ranking-panel]').forEach(panel => {
      let visible = 0;
      const rows = panel.querySelectorAll('tr[data-ranking-dealer]');
      rows.forEach(row => {
        const show = !hasSelection || selected.has(row.dataset.rankingDealer);
        row.classList.toggle('hidden', !show);
        if (show) visible += 1;
      });
      panel.querySelector('[data-ranking-filter-empty]')?.classList.toggle('hidden', rows.length === 0 || visible > 0);
    });
    if (rankingSelection) {
      rankingSelection.textContent = hasSelection
        ? `${selected.size} concessionária${selected.size === 1 ? '' : 's'} selecionada${selected.size === 1 ? '' : 's'}`
        : 'Exibindo todas as concessionárias';
    }
    rankingClear?.classList.toggle('hidden', !hasSelection);
  }

  function canvasToBlob(canvas) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => canvas.toBlob(blob => {
      if (blob) resolve(blob);
      else reject(new Error('Não foi possível gerar a imagem.'));
    }, 'image/png'));
  }

  function downloadBlob(blob, fileName) {
    if (!blob?.size) throw new Error('O arquivo gerado está vazio.');
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.download = fileName;
    link.rel = 'noopener';
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 5000);
  }

  function shareableFile(blob, fileName) {
    if (typeof File !== 'function') return null;
    try { return new File([blob], fileName, { type: blob.type || 'application/octet-stream' }); }
    catch (_) { return null; }
  }

  function canShareFile(file) {
    if (!file || !navigator.share) return false;
    if (typeof navigator.canShare !== 'function') return true;
    try { return navigator.canShare({ files: [file] }); }
    catch (_) { return false; }
  }

  async function copyImageBlob(blob) {
    if (!navigator.clipboard?.write || typeof ClipboardItem !== 'function') {
      throw new Error('A cópia automática de imagens não está disponível neste navegador.');
    }
    await navigator.clipboard.write([new ClipboardItem({ 'image/png': blob })]);
  }

  let activeImagePreviewCleanup = null;
  function showImageCopyFallback(blob) {
    activeImagePreviewCleanup?.();
    const imageUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const overlay = document.createElement('div');
    overlay.className = 'image-copy-preview';
    overlay.setAttribute('role', 'dialog');
    overlay.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true');
    overlay.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', 'imageCopyPreviewTitle');
    overlay.innerHTML = `
      <div class="image-copy-preview-card">
        <div class="image-copy-preview-head">
          <div>
            <strong id="imageCopyPreviewTitle">Imagem pronta para copiar</strong>
            <small>O navegador bloqueou a cópia automática.</small>
          </div>
          <button type="button" class="image-copy-preview-close" aria-label="Fechar">×</button>
        </div>
        <p>Clique em “Tentar copiar novamente”. Se o bloqueio continuar, clique com o botão direito na imagem (ou pressione e segure no celular) e escolha copiar.</p>
        <div class="image-copy-preview-canvas"><img alt="Prévia da imagem gerada"></div>
        <div class="image-copy-preview-actions">
          <span role="status" aria-live="polite"></span>
          <button type="button" class="export" data-image-copy-retry>Tentar copiar novamente</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    overlay.querySelector('img').src = imageUrl;
    document.body.appendChild(overlay);

    const onKeyDown = event => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') cleanup();
    };
    const cleanup = () => {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
      overlay.remove();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(imageUrl);
      if (activeImagePreviewCleanup === cleanup) activeImagePreviewCleanup = null;
    };
    activeImagePreviewCleanup = cleanup;
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    overlay.querySelector('.image-copy-preview-close').addEventListener('click', cleanup);
    overlay.addEventListener('click', event => {
      if (event.target === overlay) cleanup();
    });
    overlay.querySelector('[data-image-copy-retry]').addEventListener('click', async event => {
      const button = event.currentTarget;
      const status = overlay.querySelector('[role="status"]');
      try {
        button.disabled = true;
        button.textContent = 'Copiando...';
        await copyImageBlob(blob);
        status.className = 'success';
        status.textContent = 'Imagem copiada. Use Ctrl+V para colar.';
        button.textContent = 'Imagem copiada';
        setTimeout(cleanup, 1000);
      } catch (_) {
        status.className = 'error';
        status.textContent = 'A cópia ainda está bloqueada. Copie pela própria imagem acima.';
        button.textContent = 'Tentar copiar novamente';
        button.disabled = false;
      }
    });
    overlay.querySelector('[data-image-copy-retry]').focus();
  }

  async function distributeGeneratedImage(generateBlob, fileName, options = {}) {
    const blob = await generateBlob();

    if (options.clipboardOnly) {
      try {
        await copyImageBlob(blob);
        return 'copied';
      } catch (_) {
        showImageCopyFallback(blob);
        return 'previewed';
      }
    }

    const file = shareableFile(blob, fileName);
    const mobile = /Android|iPhone|iPad|iPod/i.test(navigator.userAgent || '');

    if (mobile && canShareFile(file)) {
      try {
        await navigator.share({ files: [file], title: 'Dashboard de Qualidade Geely' });
        return 'shared';
      } catch (error) {
        if (error?.name === 'AbortError') return 'cancelled';
      }
    }

    if (options.preferDownload) {
      downloadBlob(blob, fileName);
      return 'downloaded';
    }

    if (navigator.clipboard && window.ClipboardItem) {
      try {
        await copyImageBlob(blob);
        return 'copied';
      } catch (_) {
        // Mantém compartilhamento ou download como alternativa.
      }
    }

    if (canShareFile(file)) {
      try {
        await navigator.share({ files: [file], title: 'Dashboard de Qualidade Geely' });
        return 'shared';
      } catch (error) {
        if (error?.name === 'AbortError') return 'cancelled';
      }
    }

    downloadBlob(blob, fileName);
    return 'downloaded';
  }

  window.geelyImageTools = { canvasToBlob, distributeGeneratedImage };

  const summaryImageDataElement = document.getElementById('summaryImageData');
  const summaryImageButton = document.querySelector('[data-summary-image]');
  const summaryImageStatus = document.querySelector('[data-summary-image-status]');
  let summaryImageData = null;
  try { summaryImageData = JSON.parse(summaryImageDataElement?.textContent || 'null'); }
  catch (_) { summaryImageData = null; }

  function fitSummaryCanvasText(context, value, maxWidth) {
    const text = String(value ?? '-');
    if (context.measureText(text).width <= maxWidth) return text;
    let shortened = text;
    while (shortened.length && context.measureText(`${shortened}…`).width > maxWidth) shortened = shortened.slice(0, -1);
    return `${shortened}…`;
  }

  function summaryValue(value, kpi) {
    if (value == null || Number.isNaN(value)) return '-';
    if (kpi === 'quantidade') return Math.round(value).toLocaleString('pt-BR');
    if (['estrelas', 'nota_test_drive'].includes(kpi)) return Number(value).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');
    return `${Number(value).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}%`;
  }

  function summaryValueStatus(channel, kpi, value) {
    const objective = summaryImageData?.objetivos?.[channel]?.[kpi];
    if (value == null || Number.isNaN(value) || objective == null) return 'neutral';
    const lowerIsBetter = (summaryImageData.menor_melhor || []).includes(kpi);
    return (lowerIsBetter ? value <= objective : value >= objective) ? 'good' : 'bad';
  }

  function summaryMetricLabel(channel, kpi) {
    const label = summaryImageData.rotulos?.[channel]?.[kpi] || kpi;
    const objective = summaryImageData.objetivos?.[channel]?.[kpi];
    const displayLabel = /^q[123]$/.test(kpi) ? `MOT · ${label}` : label;
    return objective == null ? displayLabel : `${displayLabel} · Obj. ${summaryValue(objective, kpi)}`;
  }

  function summaryBrazilRegionsImage() {
    if (!summaryImageData?.geografias?.length) throw new Error('Não há informações para montar o resumo.');
    const periods = ['mtd', 'ytd'];
    const periodNames = { mtd: 'MTD', ytd: 'YTD' };
    const width = 1500;
    const margin = 24;
    const channelGap = 20;
    const channelWidth = (width - margin * 2 - channelGap) / 2;
    const metricWidth = 420;
    const periodWidth = (channelWidth - metricWidth) / periods.length;
    const titleHeight = 94;
    const geographyTitleHeight = 36;
    const channelTitleHeight = 36;
    const columnHeaderHeight = 30;
    const rowHeight = 32;
    const channelRows = Math.max(
      summaryImageData.kpis?.vn?.length || 0,
      summaryImageData.kpis?.pv?.length || 0,
    );
    const channelHeight = channelTitleHeight + columnHeaderHeight + channelRows * rowHeight;
    const geographyGap = 18;
    const geographyHeight = geographyTitleHeight + channelHeight + geographyGap;
    const legendHeight = 40;
    const height = titleHeight + summaryImageData.geografias.length * geographyHeight + legendHeight;
    const scale = height <= 14000 ? 2 : 1;
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = width * scale;
    canvas.height = height * scale;
    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!context) throw new Error('O navegador não conseguiu preparar a imagem.');
    context.scale(scale, scale);
    context.fillStyle = '#f3f7f9';
    context.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    context.fillStyle = '#071e2a';
    context.fillRect(0, 0, width, titleHeight);
    context.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    context.font = '800 26px Arial, sans-serif';
    context.fillText('Resumo Brasil e Regiões', margin, 36);
    const periodText = periods.map(period => `${periodNames[period]}: ${summaryImageData.periodos?.[period] || '-'}`).join(' · ');
    context.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.78)';
    context.font = '700 13px Arial, sans-serif';
    context.fillText(
      fitSummaryCanvasText(context, `Data do relatório: ${summaryImageData.data_relatorio} · ${periodText}`, width - margin * 2),
      margin,
      65,
    );

    summaryImageData.geografias.forEach((geography, geographyIndex) => {
      const top = titleHeight + geographyIndex * geographyHeight;
      const isBrazil = geographyIndex === 0;
      context.fillStyle = isBrazil ? '#ddeff7' : '#e8eef1';
      context.fillRect(margin, top, width - margin * 2, geographyTitleHeight);
      context.fillStyle = isBrazil ? '#004a73' : '#17242b';
      context.font = '800 16px Arial, sans-serif';
      context.fillText(geography.nome, margin + 12, top + 24);

      ['vn', 'pv'].forEach((channel, channelIndex) => {
        const channelX = margin + channelIndex * (channelWidth + channelGap);
        const channelY = top + geographyTitleHeight;
        const mainColor = channel === 'vn' ? '#f6d96b' : '#6d757a';
        const lightColor = channel === 'vn' ? '#fff6d7' : '#eef0f1';
        const headerText = channel === 'vn' ? '#40370d' : '#ffffff';
        context.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
        context.fillRect(channelX, channelY, channelWidth, channelHeight);
        context.fillStyle = mainColor;
        context.fillRect(channelX, channelY, channelWidth, channelTitleHeight);
        context.fillStyle = headerText;
        context.font = '800 15px Arial, sans-serif';
        context.fillText(channel === 'vn' ? 'Vendas' : 'Pós-Venda', channelX + 11, channelY + 24);

        const headerY = channelY + channelTitleHeight;
        context.fillStyle = lightColor;
        context.fillRect(channelX, headerY, channelWidth, columnHeaderHeight);
        context.fillStyle = '#263238';
        context.font = '800 11px Arial, sans-serif';
        context.fillText('Indicador', channelX + 9, headerY + 20);
        periods.forEach((period, periodIndex) => {
          const periodX = channelX + metricWidth + periodIndex * periodWidth;
          context.fillText(periodNames[period], periodX + 9, headerY + 20);
        });

        const kpis = summaryImageData.kpis?.[channel] || [];
        for (let rowIndex = 0; rowIndex < channelRows; rowIndex += 1) {
          const kpi = kpis[rowIndex];
          const rowY = headerY + columnHeaderHeight + rowIndex * rowHeight;
          context.fillStyle = rowIndex % 2 ? '#f8fafb' : '#ffffff';
          context.fillRect(channelX, rowY, channelWidth, rowHeight);
          if (kpi) {
            context.fillStyle = '#17242b';
            context.font = '700 11px Arial, sans-serif';
            context.fillText(
              fitSummaryCanvasText(context, summaryMetricLabel(channel, kpi), metricWidth - 18),
              channelX + 9,
              rowY + 21,
            );
            periods.forEach((period, periodIndex) => {
              const value = geography.canais?.[channel]?.[period]?.[kpi];
              const status = summaryValueStatus(channel, kpi, value);
              const periodX = channelX + metricWidth + periodIndex * periodWidth;
              context.fillStyle = status === 'good' ? '#138a45' : status === 'bad' ? '#d22929' : '#667780';
              context.font = `${status === 'neutral' ? '700' : '800'} 12px Arial, sans-serif`;
              context.fillText(
                fitSummaryCanvasText(context, summaryValue(value, kpi), periodWidth - 18),
                periodX + 9,
                rowY + 21,
              );
            });
          }
          context.strokeStyle = '#d4dee3';
          context.beginPath();
          context.moveTo(channelX, rowY + rowHeight);
          context.lineTo(channelX + channelWidth, rowY + rowHeight);
          context.stroke();
        }

        context.strokeStyle = '#d4dee3';
        const verticalOffsets = [
          0,
          metricWidth,
          ...periods.map((_, index) => metricWidth + periodWidth * (index + 1)),
        ];
        verticalOffsets.forEach(offset => {
          context.beginPath();
          context.moveTo(channelX + offset, headerY);
          context.lineTo(channelX + offset, channelY + channelHeight);
          context.stroke();
        });
        context.strokeRect(channelX, channelY, channelWidth, channelHeight);
      });
    });

    const legendY = height - legendHeight;
    context.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    context.fillRect(0, legendY, width, legendHeight);
    context.font = '700 11px Arial, sans-serif';
    context.fillStyle = '#138a45';
    context.fillText('Verde: objetivo atingido', margin, legendY + 25);
    context.fillStyle = '#d22929';
    context.fillText('Vermelho: objetivo não atingido', margin + 180, legendY + 25);
    context.fillStyle = '#667780';
    context.fillText('Valores sem objetivo permanecem neutros', margin + 400, legendY + 25);
    return canvasToBlob(canvas);
  }

  if (summaryImageButton && summaryImageData) {
    summaryImageButton.dataset.summaryGeographies = String(summaryImageData.geografias.length);
    summaryImageButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const originalLabel = summaryImageButton.textContent;
      try {
        summaryImageButton.disabled = true;
        summaryImageButton.textContent = 'Gerando imagem...';
        if (summaryImageStatus) {
          summaryImageStatus.className = 'summary-image-status';
          summaryImageStatus.textContent = 'Compilando Brasil e regionais...';
        }
        const result = await distributeGeneratedImage(
          summaryBrazilRegionsImage,
          'resumo_brasil_regionais_geely.png',
          { clipboardOnly: true },
        );
        if (summaryImageStatus) {
          summaryImageStatus.className = 'summary-image-status success';
          summaryImageStatus.textContent = result === 'copied'
            ? 'Imagem copiada. Use Ctrl+V para colar.'
            : 'A prévia foi aberta para você copiar a imagem.';
        }
        summaryImageButton.textContent = result === 'copied' ? 'Imagem copiada' : 'Prévia aberta';
      } catch (error) {
        if (summaryImageStatus) {
          summaryImageStatus.className = 'summary-image-status error';
          summaryImageStatus.textContent = error.message || 'Não foi possível copiar a imagem Resumo.';
        }
        summaryImageButton.textContent = originalLabel;
      } finally {
        summaryImageButton.disabled = false;
        setTimeout(() => { summaryImageButton.textContent = originalLabel; }, 1800);
      }
    });
  }

  function rankingMtdImage() {
    const panel = document.querySelector('[data-ranking-panel].active');
    if (!panel) throw new Error('Não foi possível localizar o ranking ativo.');
    const channel = panel.dataset.rankingPanel;
    const rows = [...panel.querySelectorAll('tr[data-ranking-dealer]')]
      .filter(row => !row.classList.contains('hidden'))
      .map(row => [
        row.cells[0]?.textContent.trim() || '-',
        row.cells[1]?.querySelector('strong')?.textContent.trim() || '-',
        row.cells[2]?.textContent.trim() || '-',
        row.cells[5]?.textContent.trim() || '-',
        row.cells[6]?.textContent.trim() || '-',
        row.cells[7]?.textContent.trim() || '-',
      ]);
    if (!rows.length) throw new Error('Não há concessionárias visíveis para copiar.');

    const columns = [90, 350, 210, 170, 160, 180];
    const width = columns.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
    const titleHeight = 52;
    const headerHeight = 38;
    const rowHeight = 34;
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = width;
    canvas.height = titleHeight + headerHeight + rows.length * rowHeight;
    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const mainColor = channel === 'vn' ? '#f6d96b' : '#6d757a';
    const lightColor = channel === 'vn' ? '#fff6d7' : '#eef0f1';
    const channelName = channel === 'vn' ? 'Vendas' : 'Pós-Venda';
    context.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    context.fillRect(0, 0, width, canvas.height);
    context.fillStyle = mainColor;
    context.fillRect(0, 0, width, titleHeight);
    context.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    context.font = '800 21px Arial, sans-serif';
    context.fillText(`Ranking ${channelName} — Resultados MTD`, 18, 33);

    const headers = ['Posição', 'Concessionária', 'Regional', 'NPS MTD', 'Qtd MTD', 'Dif. D-1'];
    context.fillStyle = lightColor;
    context.fillRect(0, titleHeight, width, headerHeight);
    context.font = '700 14px Arial, sans-serif';
    context.fillStyle = '#263238';
    let x = 0;
    headers.forEach((header, index) => {
      context.fillText(header, x + 10, titleHeight + 25);
      x += columns[index];
    });

    rows.forEach((row, rowIndex) => {
      const y = titleHeight + headerHeight + rowIndex * rowHeight;
      context.fillStyle = rowIndex % 2 ? '#f8fafb' : '#ffffff';
      context.fillRect(0, y, width, rowHeight);
      context.strokeStyle = '#d4dee3';
      context.lineWidth = 1;
      context.beginPath();
      context.moveTo(0, y + rowHeight);
      context.lineTo(width, y + rowHeight);
      context.stroke();
      context.font = '600 13px Arial, sans-serif';
      let cellX = 0;
      row.forEach((value, index) => {
        const text = value.length > 42 && index >= 1 && index <= 2 ? `${value.slice(0, 39)}...` : value;
        const numericValue = Number(value.replace(/\./g, '').replace(',', '.').replace(/[^\d+.-]/g, ''));
        context.fillStyle = index === 3 && Number.isFinite(numericValue)
          ? (numericValue >= 80 ? '#138a45' : '#d22929')
          : index === 5 && /^\+/.test(value) ? '#138a45'
            : index === 5 && /^-\d/.test(value) ? '#d22929'
              : '#17242b';
        context.fillText(text, cellX + 10, y + 22);
        cellX += columns[index];
      });
    });
    return canvasToBlob(canvas);
  }

  rankingSearch?.addEventListener('input', filterRankingOptions);

  document.querySelector('[data-summary-excel]')?.addEventListener('click', async event => {
    if (!summaryImageData) return;
    const button = event.currentTarget;
    const original = button.textContent;
    const periods = ['mtd', 'ytd'];
    const periodLabels = { mtd: 'MTD', ytd: 'YTD' };
    const metricKind = kpi => kpi === 'quantidade' ? 'integer'
      : ['estrelas','nota_test_drive'].includes(kpi) ? 'decimal' : 'percent';
    const metricState = (channel,kpi,value) => {
      const objective=summaryImageData.objetivos?.[channel]?.[kpi];
      if(value==null||objective==null)return'neutral';
      return (summaryImageData.menor_melhor||[]).includes(kpi)
        ? (value<=objective?'good':'bad') : (value>=objective?'good':'bad');
    };
    try {
      button.textContent = 'Gerando arquivo...';
      const sheets = ['vn','pv'].map(channel => {
        const rows = [];
        summaryImageData.geografias.forEach(geo => {
        const channelData = geo.canais?.[channel];
        if (!channelData) return;
        (summaryImageData.kpis?.[channel] || []).forEach(kpi => {
            periods.forEach(period => rows.push({
              level: geo.nome === 'Brasil' ? 'brazil' : 'region',
              cells: [
                { v: geo.nome, kind: 'text' },
                { v: channel === 'vn' ? 'Vendas' : 'Pós-Venda', kind: 'text' },
                { v: summaryImageData.rotulos?.[channel]?.[kpi] || kpi, kind: 'text' },
                { v: summaryImageData.objetivos?.[channel]?.[kpi], kind: metricKind(kpi) },
                { v: periodLabels[period], kind: 'text' },
                { v: channelData?.[period]?.[kpi], kind: metricKind(kpi), state: metricState(channel,kpi,channelData?.[period]?.[kpi]) },
              ],
            }));
          });
        });
        return {
          name: channel === 'vn' ? 'Vendas' : 'Pós-Venda', channel,
          title: `Resumo KPIs · ${channel === 'vn' ? 'Vendas' : 'Pós-Venda'}`,
          subtitle: `Data do relatório: ${summaryImageData.data_relatorio} · Arquivo formatado Geely`,
          headers: ['Geografia','Canal','KPI','Objetivo','Período','Resultado'],
          widths: [22,16,44,16,14,18], rows,
        };
      });
      const datePart = String(summaryImageData.data_relatorio || '').replace(/\D+/g, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, '');
      await window.GeelyExcel.downloadReliable(sheets, `Resumo_KPIs_Geely_${datePart || 'atual'}.xlsx`);
      button.textContent = 'Arquivo gerado';
      if (summaryImageStatus) { summaryImageStatus.className='summary-image-status success'; summaryImageStatus.textContent='Excel formatado baixado.'; }
    } catch (error) {
      button.textContent = 'Não foi possível gerar';
      if (summaryImageStatus) { summaryImageStatus.className='summary-image-status error'; summaryImageStatus.textContent=error.message || 'Falha ao gerar o Excel.'; }
    } finally { setTimeout(() => { button.textContent = original; }, 1800); }
  });

    document.querySelectorAll('[data-model-kpi-pane]').forEach(pane => pane.classList.toggle('active', pane.dataset.modelKpiPane === target));

  function setMotsMenu(open) {
    if (!motsFilter || !motsToggle) return;

  function filterMotsOptions() {
    const search = normalizeSearch(motsSearch?.value);
    let visible = 0;
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-mots-dealer-option]').forEach(option => {
      const show = !search || (option.dataset.search || '').includes(search);
      option.classList.toggle('hidden', !show);
      if (show) visible += 1;
    });
    document.querySelector('[data-mots-dealer-no-results]')?.classList.toggle('hidden', visible > 0);
  }

  function filterMotsGroupOptions() {
    const search = normalizeSearch(motsGroupSearch?.value);
    let visible = 0;
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-mots-group-option]').forEach(option => {
      const show = !search || (option.dataset.search || '').includes(search);
      option.classList.toggle('hidden', !show);
      if (show) visible += 1;
    });
    document.querySelector('[data-mots-group-no-results]')?.classList.toggle('hidden', visible > 0);
  }

  function filterMotsRows() {
    const selected = new Set(motsChoices.filter(choice => choice.checked).map(choice => choice.value));
    const selectedGroups = new Set(
      motsGroupChoices.filter(choice => choice.checked).map(choice => choice.value),
    );
    const hasSelection = selected.size > 0;
    const hasGroupSelection = selectedGroups.size > 0;
    const metric = motsSortMetric?.value || 'position';

    const numericValue = (row, key) => {
      const raw = row.dataset[key];
      if (raw == null || raw === '' || raw === '-') return null;
      const value = Number(raw);
      return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : null;
    };

    const compareRows = (left, right) => {
      const leftValue = numericValue(left, `mots${metric[0].toUpperCase()}${metric.slice(1)}`);
      const rightValue = numericValue(right, `mots${metric[0].toUpperCase()}${metric.slice(1)}`);
      if (leftValue == null && rightValue != null) return 1;
      if (leftValue != null && rightValue == null) return -1;
      if (leftValue != null && rightValue != null && leftValue !== rightValue) {
        const bestFirst = motsSortDirection === 'desc';
        if (metric === 'position') return bestFirst ? leftValue - rightValue : rightValue - leftValue;
        return bestFirst ? rightValue - leftValue : leftValue - rightValue;
      }
      return (numericValue(left, 'motsOriginalIndex') ?? 0)
        - (numericValue(right, 'motsOriginalIndex') ?? 0);
    };

    document.querySelectorAll('[data-mots-panel]').forEach(panel => {
      let visible = 0;
      const groupPanel = String(panel.dataset.motsPanel || '').startsWith('group-');
      const requiredMots = panel.classList.contains('channel-vn') ? ['motsQ1', 'motsQ2', 'motsQ3'] : ['motsQ1', 'motsQ2'];
      const rows = [...panel.querySelectorAll('tr[data-mots-row]')];
      rows.forEach(row => {
        if (row.dataset.motsBrasil === 'true') {
          row.classList.remove('hidden');
          return;
        }
        const dealerMatch = groupPanel || !hasSelection || selected.has(row.dataset.motsDealer);
        const groupMatch = !hasGroupSelection || selectedGroups.has(row.dataset.motsGroup);
        const goalsMatch = !motsAllOver90 || requiredMots.every(key => {
          const value = numericValue(row, key);
          return value != null && value >= 90;
        });
        const show = dealerMatch && groupMatch && goalsMatch;
        row.classList.toggle('hidden', !show);
        if (show) visible += 1;
      });
      panel.querySelectorAll('tbody').forEach(body => {
        const sortableRows = [...body.querySelectorAll('tr[data-mots-row]')]
          .filter(row => row.dataset.motsBrasil !== 'true')
          .sort(compareRows);
        sortableRows.forEach(row => body.appendChild(row));
        let filteredPosition = 0;
        sortableRows.forEach(row => {
          const positionCell = row.querySelector('.rank-position');
          if (!positionCell) return;
          const matchesAllGoals = requiredMots.every(key => {
            const value = numericValue(row, key);
            return value != null && value >= 90;
          });
          if (motsAllOver90 && matchesAllGoals) {
            filteredPosition += 1;
            positionCell.textContent = String(filteredPosition);
          } else {
            positionCell.textContent = row.dataset.motsPosition || '-';
          }
        });
        const brazilRow = body.querySelector('tr[data-mots-brasil="true"]');
        if (brazilRow) body.appendChild(brazilRow);
      });
      panel.querySelector('[data-mots-filter-empty]')?.classList.toggle('hidden', visible > 0);
    });
    if (motsSelection) {
      motsSelection.textContent = hasSelection
        ? `${selected.size} concessionária${selected.size === 1 ? '' : 's'} selecionada${selected.size === 1 ? '' : 's'}`
        : 'Todas as concessionárias';
    }
    motsClear?.classList.toggle('hidden', !hasSelection);
    if (motsGroupSelection) {
      motsGroupSelection.textContent = hasGroupSelection
        ? `${selectedGroups.size} grupo${selectedGroups.size === 1 ? '' : 's'} selecionado${selectedGroups.size === 1 ? '' : 's'}`
        : 'Todos os grupos';
    }
    motsGroupClear?.classList.toggle('hidden', !hasGroupSelection);
  }

  motsSearch?.addEventListener('input', filterMotsOptions);

  motsToggle?.addEventListener('click', () => setMotsMenu(!motsFilter?.classList.contains('open')));
  motsGroupSearch?.addEventListener('input', filterMotsGroupOptions);
  motsGroupChoices.forEach(choice => choice.addEventListener('change', filterMotsRows));

    toggleControls.textContent = collapsed ? 'Mostrar opções' : 'Recolher';
    toggleControls.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const next = !controls.classList.contains('collapsed');
      controls.classList.toggle('collapsed', next);
      toggleControls.textContent = next ? 'Mostrar opções' : 'Recolher';
      storageSet('geely.controlsCollapsed', next ? '1' : '0');
